content: Much like the objective in Eq (DISPLAY_FORM5) we can compute unbiased gradients by replacing the expectations with their averages over random minibatches. Although gradient descent guarantees convergence on Eq (DISPLAY_FORM7) only when the objective is convex, we find that not only is the optimization stable, the resulting solution achieves better performance than the weighting approach in Eq (DISPLAY_FORM5).
